English:
Crazy to think Dhaos has
been hiding his castle in a time rift...
If anyone's capable of such a thing, it's him.

Everyone, please lend me your
strength to save this world...and your future.

No need to ask. All of us
want to put an end to Dhaos.
Now, let's get on with it.
Even I'm starting to feel a bit homesick.
